summary: Preserve legacy action receipt and identity conflict codes in client-v0 errors

replay.detail: Existing action receipts are neither rewritten nor replayed differently.

schema.detail: The client error schema and generated clients recognize legacy-action-receipt-untrusted. No database migration is required.

rules.detail: Client-v0 error normalization preserves legacy-action-receipt-untrusted, identity-cycle, identity-occupied and identity-retired-source instead of reporting internal.

compatibility.detail: Legacy action receipt refusals remain HTTP 409 with retryable false and now expose the documented code. Older clients can handle the unknown code using retryable.

recovery.detail: Inspect the original outcome before choosing a new idempotency key for a refused legacy receipt.
